notice: TEST FIXTURE WITH RANDOM, UNTRAINED WEIGHTS. It does not extract any speaker. It exists only to test the streaming-tse-stft-onnx/1 tensor contract and the C# STFT/overlap-add adapter against a Python reference.

model.architecture: pGTCRN, channels 16, FiLM on a 256-dim embedding (tools/models/tse/pgtcrn.py)

reference.input: pgtcrn-fixture-input.f32 (float32 little endian, 32000 samples, 16 kHz, from synthetic-overlap-A2-B2.wav)
reference.embedding: pgtcrn-fixture-embedding.f32 (float32, 256 values, random unit vector, seed 1234)
reference.expected: pgtcrn-fixture-expected.f32 (float32, 32000 samples): streaming STFT (n_fft 512, hop 256, periodic sqrt-Hann, zero history) -> ONNX Runtime 1.31 frame by frame -> inverse FFT with the same window and overlap-add; output delayed by n_fft - hop = 256 samples
reference.tolerance_note: C# adapter vs this reference measured at 3.3e-7 max abs difference (2026-10-09)
